## Objective

To clean covariates, microRNA, and mRNA sequencing data needed to build transcriptome-wide, placental miRNA-–mRNA regulatory networks using CANDLE data.

We will use the implementation of ComBat-seq from the `sva` package. 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  ## tidy data framework, ggplot2, pipes
library(assertthat) ## sanity checks
library(here)       ## sets path nicely for markdown
library(edgeR)      ## differential expression analysis; limma/voom dependencies
library(sva)        ## for ComBat-seq
library(table1)     ## for labels function for table1 style tables
library(arsenal)    ## for nicely formatted demographics table
```
 
First, we will load all the data.

```{r}
## Load covariates from prior pulls
## First: Prior data from pull p0047, used in the AJOG sPTB paper
p0047_candle <- readr::read_csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/sPTB_PlacentalTranscriptome_CANDLE/RawData/p0047_candle.csv")

## Second: from pull p0109, used in the vitamin D analysis
p0109_data <- readr::read_csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/sPTB_PlacentalTranscriptome_CANDLE/RawData/p0109_data.csv")

## mRNA data
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/sPTB_PlacentalTranscriptome_CANDLE/RawData/candle_20200226.Rdata")
## loads annot, batches, candle_counts, candle_lengthScaledTPM and function fixCounts

## before we go forward, let's match up the batch information
## match batches data to pathways_id 
## code from Alison's CRH analysis in CANDLE 
## CRH_PreliminaryDataPreprocessing_3102023.Rmd
rownames(batches) <- colnames(candle_counts$counts)
batches$pathways_id <- colnames(candle_counts$counts)

## let's save annot as annot_mRNA
annot_mRNA <- annot
rm(annot)

## miRNA data
## load the data from both batches
## ONLY USE BATCH ONE as the source of IDs for sequencing batch
all_mirs <- readRDS("/Volumes/paquette_a/CANDLE_miRNA/RawData/all_mirs_20240718.Rds")

batch_one_mirs <- readRDS("/Volumes/paquette_a/CANDLE_miRNA/RawData/batch_one_mirs_20240718.Rds")
```

## Filter covariate by inclusion criteria

```{r}
## sanity check (make sure all 765 miRNA samples and all 794 mRNA samples match)
p0047_candle$pathways_id %in% colnames(as.data.frame(all_mirs)) |> sum() 
p0047_candle$pathways_id %in% colnames(candle_counts$counts) |> sum()

## list IDs
ids_mRNA <- colnames(candle_counts$counts) |> unique()
ids_miRNA <- colnames(all_mirs)[-1] |> unique()

## confirm the size of the intersect, 765
ids_miRNA %in% ids_mRNA |> sum()

## keep ids
pathways_ids_to_keep <- ids_miRNA[ids_miRNA %in% ids_mRNA]

## generate a miRNA sequencing variable
miRNA_batches <- tibble::tibble(pathways_id = ids_miRNA) |>
  dplyr::mutate(mir_batch = dplyr::if_else(pathways_id %in% colnames(batch_one_mirs) == TRUE, 1, 2) |> factor())
```

## Filter covariate data by exclusion criteria

```{r}
covar <- p0047_candle |>
  ## filter to correct IDs
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% pathways_ids_to_keep) |>
  ## from 1503 to 765
  ## remove participants with placental abruption, preeclampsia, or chorioamnionitis or NA values
  dplyr::filter(m_chorio == "0" & h_placental_abrupt == "0" & m_preeclam == "0") |>
  ## from 765 to 753
  ## also other hypertension variables
  
  dplyr::filter(m1mb_chtn == "0") |> ## Chronic HTN in current pregnancy at M1 (NA = 5)
  dplyr::filter(m1mb_chtn2 == "0") |> ## Chronic HTN ever (NA = 5)
  dplyr::filter(ld_gesthtn4 == "0") |> ## PE or gHTN diagnosed since last visit at delivery (NA = 56)
  dplyr::filter(ld_cshtn == "0" | is.na(ld_cshtn) == TRUE) |> ## C-section indication: PE/HTN
  dplyr::filter(ld_mhtn == "0" | is.na(ld_mhtn) == TRUE) |> ## Delivery classifcation: PTB--PE/HTN
  ## From 753 to 691
  ## NOTE: we DO NOT remove induced labors here
  ## add in the miRNA batch; use left join to only match filtered data
  dplyr::left_join(miRNA_batches, by = join_by(pathways_id)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(batches |> dplyr::select(pathways_id, mRNA_batch = Analysis),
                   by = join_by(pathways_id))
```

Now that we have cleaned our covariate data, we can use the participant IDs for the sequencing data. At this point, only batch data will be used as a covariate. 

## Clean and filter the miRNA data

Here, I am adapting code from Alison's CRH analysis in CANDLE (CRH_PreliminaryDataPreprocessing_3102023.Rmd) and her miRNA cleaning.

```{r}
Counts <- all_mirs[, covar$pathways_id] |>
  ## force as matrix
  scale(center = FALSE, scale = FALSE)

## make an annotation file
rownames(Counts) <- all_mirs$Name

annot_mir <- data.frame(name = all_mirs$Name, 
                miRNA = dplyr::if_else(str_detect(all_mirs$Name, "miR"), 1, 0),
                piRNA = dplyr::if_else(str_detect(all_mirs$Name, "piR"), 1, 0)) |>
  ## the let miRNAs aren't labled, so let's fix that
  dplyr::mutate(miRNA = dplyr::if_else(str_detect(all_mirs$Name, "let"), 1, miRNA))

rownames(annot_mir) <- annot_mir$name

## sanity check 
table(annot_mir$miRNA, annot_mir$piRNA)

print("Original")
print(dim(Counts)[1])
print(dim(annot_mir)[1])

## there are some NAs that need to be turned to 1s since cpm cannot handle them
Counts[is.na(Counts)] <- 0

## Remove piRNA
annot_mir <- annot_mir |> 
  dplyr::filter(miRNA == 1)
Counts <- Counts[annot_mir$name, ]

## ComBat-seq

Counts <- sva::ComBat_seq(counts = Counts, 
                          batch = factor(covar$mir_batch))

## Get CPM & Log Transform
cpm <- cpm(Counts, log = TRUE)

## filter based on low expression
## this is a stringent limit, but seems to provide good quality data
keep <- rowMeans(cpm) > 0
summary(keep)

cpm_filt <- cpm[keep, ]
annot_mir <- annot_mir[keep, ]
counts_filt <- Counts[keep, ]

print("Filtering")
print(dim(cpm_filt)[1])
print(dim(annot_mir)[1])
print(dim(counts_filt)[1])

plot(density(cpm), main="Before Filtering")
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
plot(density(cpm_filt), main="After Filtering")
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

Y <- DGEList(counts = counts_filt)

boxplot(Y$counts[, 1:10])
boxplot(cpm[, 1:10])
boxplot(cpm(Y, log = T)[, 1:10])
Y <- calcNormFactors(Y, method = "TMM") # This is the Default Method
boxplot(cpm(Y, log = T)[, 1:10])

### Calculate CPM
CPM_mir <- cpm(Y, log = T)

rownames(CPM_mir) <- rownames(counts_filt)

miRNA <- Y

rm(batch_one_mirs, all_mirs, Counts, counts_filt, cpm, cpm_filt, p0109_data, Y, 
   ids_miRNA, ids_mRNA, keep, pathways_ids_to_keep)
```

Write this data to a file. 

```{r}
save(miRNA, annot_mir, CPM_mir,
     file = here::here("network_construction", "intermediateData", "clean_miRNA.RData"))
```

## Clean and filter the mRNA data

```{r}
Counts <- candle_counts$counts[, covar$pathways_id]
LSCounts <- candle_lengthScaledTPM$counts[, covar$pathways_id]
LSLength <- candle_lengthScaledTPM$counts[, covar$pathways_id]

print("Original")
print(dim(annot_mRNA)[1])
print(dim(Counts)[1])
print(dim(LSCounts)[1])
print(dim(LSLength)[1])

#get rownames of count dataset to match annot$ENSEMBL by removing the "." and 
# everything after it
rownames(Counts) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(Counts))
rownames(LSCounts) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(LSCounts))
rownames(LSLength) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(LSLength))

annot_mRNA <- subset(annot_mRNA, BIOTYPE == "protein_coding") |>
  droplevels()
Counts <- Counts[as.character(annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL), ]
LSCounts <- LSCounts[as.character(annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL), ]
LSLength <- LSLength[as.character(annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL), ]

print(dim(Counts)[1])
print(dim(LSCounts)[1])
print(dim(LSLength)[1])

## ComBat
Counts <- Counts |>
  ## force as matrix
  scale(center = FALSE, scale = FALSE)

LSCounts <- LSCounts |>
  ## force as matrix
  scale(center = FALSE, scale = FALSE)

Counts <- sva::ComBat_seq(counts = Counts,
                          batch = factor(covar$mRNA_batch))

LSCounts <- sva::ComBat_seq(counts = LSCounts,
                          batch = factor(covar$mRNA_batch))

# Get CPM & Log Transform
cpm <- cpm(LSCounts, log = TRUE)

# filter based on low expression
keep <- rowMeans(cpm) > 0
summary(keep)

cpm_filt <- cpm[keep, ]
counts_filt <- LSCounts[keep, ]
length_filt <- LSLength[keep, ]
annot_mRNA <- annot_mRNA[keep, ]

print("Filtering")
print(dim(cpm_filt)[1])
print(dim(counts_filt)[1])
print(dim(length_filt)[1])

plot(density(cpm), main = "Before Filtering")
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
plot(density(cpm_filt), main = "After Filtering")
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

#remove remaining duplicate genes
summary(duplicated(cpm_filt))

dupgenes <- as.character(annot_mRNA[annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL %in% rownames(cpm_filt)[duplicated(cpm_filt)], "SYMBOL"])
dupgenes

dupsymbol <- annot_mRNA |>
  dplyr::filter(duplicated(SYMBOL)) |>
  dplyr::pull(SYMBOL) |>
  as.character()
dupsymbol

annot_mRNA <- annot_mRNA[-which(annot_mRNA$SYMBOL %in% c(dupgenes, dupsymbol)), ] |>
  droplevels()
cpm_filt <- cpm_filt[rownames(cpm_filt) %in% annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL, ]
counts_filt <- counts_filt[rownames(counts_filt) %in% annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL, ]
length_filt <- length_filt[rownames(length_filt) %in% annot_mRNA$ENSEMBL, ]

table(annot_mRNA$BIOTYPE)

print("Remove Duplicates")
print(dim(annot_mRNA)[1])
print(dim(cpm_filt)[1])
print(dim(counts_filt)[1])
print(dim(length_filt)[1])

Y <- DGEList(counts = counts_filt, genes = annot_mRNA$SYMBOL)

boxplot(Y$counts[, 1:10])
boxplot(cpm[, 1:10])
boxplot(cpm(Y, log = T)[, 1:10])
Y <- calcNormFactors(Y, method = "TMM") #This is the Default Method
boxplot(cpm(Y, log = T)[, 1:10])

## CPM
CPM_mRNA <- cpm(Y, log = TRUE)

### Calculate RPKM
RPKM <- cpm(Y, log = TRUE) - log2(rowMeans(length_filt)/1000)
hist(RPKM[, 1], 101)
Y$RPKM <- RPKM

Y -> RNASeq

rm(Y, candle_counts, candle_lengthScaledTPM, Counts, counts_filt, cpm, cpm_filt, length_filt, LSCounts, LSLength, RPKM, dupgenes, dupsymbol, keep)
```

Write this data to a file. 

```{r}
save(RNASeq, annot_mRNA, CPM_mRNA,
     file = here::here("network_construction", "intermediateData", "clean_RNASeq.RData"))
```

Now, we have cleaned data, so we can move on to generating the putative list of miRNA--target mRNA interactions.
